messages:
julia: prepping a short-night toggle for `llmroute_v3_experiment`. change window 00:15-01:15 UTC. plan: 1% canary eu-west -> wait 12m -> 8% -> wait 25m -> 40% -> hold -> 100% only if all gates green. pin model to v3.0.5 for the rollout. quiet-window enforced for routing services. @deploybot schedule, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: scheduled. steps queued: 00:15 canary 1%, hold 12m, 00:27 ramp 8%, hold 25m, 00:52 ramp 40%, hold 20m, finalize 100% at 01:12 if OK. will post snapshots and step confirmations.

harry: rollback gates: sustained p95 > 480ms (5m), error-rate > 0.6% (5m), or token-queue-length > 2.8x baseline. add semantic gate: eval fail rate +2.5% on smoke prompts => rollback. also require manual check before 40% ramp.

sre-oncall: standing by. will mute noisy alerts, monitor p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue-length, and eval-pass. if ambiguous, i'll pause and escalate.

julia: rollback action: pin routing to v2.1.4 and disable flag cohorts. rollback ops command:
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_experiment --pin-version v2.1.4
```

deploybot: canary 1% executed at 00:15 UTC. metrics snapshot incoming ~00:22.

sre-oncall: snapshot 00:22: p95=310ms, error-rate=0.09%, cpu=50%, token-queue-length=1.0x baseline. prelim green. holding until full 12m.
julia: thanks team — will update release blurb once 8% goes healthy.
